BiblicalUsage: The word names the deluge, the flood of waters, and it is the word of Noah's day. God said He would bring a flood of waters upon the earth to destroy all flesh, and Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters was upon the earth. Afterward God made a covenant that the waters should no more become a flood to destroy all flesh, and the psalm says the LORD sits upon the flood, King forever.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the flood shows that God judges the world He made, and yet He sets His bow in the cloud and promises never again. I hold that the LORD sits upon the flood as King, so the waters that drown the wicked are the same waters that carry His people to dry land.
